description: The entry quantity is the bonus paid with the month. A bonus paid three times a year or less is 賞与; a computation period over six months belongs to BONUS_OVER_SIX_MONTHS.

references.title: 健康保険法 art.3(6) and 厚生年金保険法 art.3(1)(iv): a bonus paid three times a year or less is 賞与, assessed on the standard bonus amount (健保法 art.45, 厚年法 art.24の4), not the monthly grade; wages for labour insurance; withheld by the bonus rate table (所得税法 art.186(1)(ii)). The 賞与支払届 is due within 5 days (健保則 art.27, 厚年則 art.19の5). A bonus for a period over six months is BONUS_OVER_SIX_MONTHS (所得税法 art.186(2)). Entry: quantity = the bonus amount paid with the month.

eligibility: return ctx.entry.quantity > 0;

description: The entry quantity is the bonus paid for a computation period over six months. It is assessed as a bonus; under the monthly-table method the period is divided by twelve rather than six.

references.title: 所得税法 art.186(2): where the bonus computation period exceeds six months and the 月額表 method applies, the bonus is divided by twelve, not six. Otherwise as BONUS: 標準賞与額 for social insurance, a wage for labour insurance. Entry: quantity = the bonus amount; the computation period is over six months.

eligibility: return ctx.entry.quantity > 0;

description: The entry quantity is the Article 12 average-wage base for the employer-caused idle period (average daily wage multiplied by idle days). The allowance is 60% of that base; wages actually paid for the idle time reduce the base before entry.

references.title: 労働基準法26条: an employer-caused suspension requires at least60percent of the actual Article12average wage. The ordinary wages paid for the suspended time remain actual payment facts; no named average is entered. Entry: quantity = the average-wage base for the idle period; `lookup` holds the 60% rate and the average-wage source policy.

description: The entry quantity is the Article 12 average-wage base for the occupational-injury waiting days (average daily wage multiplied by waiting days, at most three). The employer pays 60% of that base.

references.title: 労働基準法76条 and 労災保険法14条: compensation for the actual occupational-injury waiting days uses60percent of the actual Article12average wage. The genuine event and covered dates remain original case/entry  Entry: quantity = the average-wage base for the waiting days (maximum three); `lookup` holds the 60% rate and the average-wage source policy.

description: The entry quantity is the Article 12 average-wage base for the notice shortfall (average daily wage multiplied by the days of notice not given, at most thirty).

references.title: 労働基準法20条 and21条: the applicable notice shortfall is paid at the actual Article12average wage. Original notice dates and an actually applicable statutory/certified exemption remain source  Taxed as retirement income under 所得税基本通達30-5. Entry: quantity = the average-wage base for the notice shortfall (maximum thirty days); `lookup` holds the average-wage source policy.

description: The entry quantity is the retirement allowance the work rules provide. It is paid after exit and taxed as retirement income; it is not remuneration or a labour-insurance wage.

references.title: No statute requires a retirement allowance; where the work rules provide one (労働基準法 art.89(iii)の2) it is paid as they state. Retirement income (所得税法 art.30), withheld by RETIREMENT_TAX; not remuneration for social insurance or wages for labour insurance. The resident tax on retirement income (10%) is withheld by RESIDENT_TAX_RETIREMENT. It is payable after the exit (payable_after_exit): withheld when paid (所得税法 arts.199, 203) on a slip of its own; no premium is charged on it. Entry: quantity = the retirement allowance amount.

eligibility: return ctx.entry.quantity > 0;

description: The retirement allowance of a leaver who filed no 退職所得の受給に関する申告書: withheld at 20.42% of the payment, with no deduction.

references.title: 所得税法
references.quote: 退職手当等の支給額に20.42パーセントの税率を乗じて計算した所得税および復興特別所得税の額を源泉徴収します。

description: The entry quantity is the cash allowance paid with the month, including any excess over the night-duty or night-meal limits. It is salary, social-insurance remuneration and a labour-insurance wage.

references.title: 所得税法 art.28: a cash allowance paid in the month is salary income, remuneration for social insurance (健保法 art.3(5)) and a wage for labour insurance — including any excess over the night-duty or night-meal limits. Entry: quantity = the cash allowance amount; `lookup` holds the night limits above which an amount belongs here.

eligibility: return ctx.entry.quantity > 0;

description: The entry quantity is the number of 宿直・日直 occasions. The catalogue pays the non-taxable limit per occasion; any excess is entered as SPECIAL_ALLOWANCE.

references.title: 所得税基本通達 28-1: a 宿直・日直 allowance up to 4,000 yen an occasion is not taxable (entry.quantity occasions; the class pays at most that, any excess is SPECIAL_ALLOWANCE). It is 報酬 for social insurance (健康保険法 art.3(5); 日本年金機構 lists 宿日直手当 as 報酬) and a wage for labour insurance (労働保険徴収法 art.2(2)). Entry: quantity = occasions; `lookup.limit_per_unit` is the non-taxable limit per occasion.

eligibility: return ctx.entry.quantity > 0;

description: The entry quantity is the number of night-work meal occasions. The catalogue pays the non-taxable limit per occasion; a payment above the limit is wholly taxable and is entered as SPECIAL_ALLOWANCE.

references.title: 昭和59年7月26日 直法6-5 as amended 令和8年3月31日: cash paid instead of a meal for night work (22:00–05:00) is not taxable up to 300 yen an occasion (entry.quantity; from 1 April 2026 650, before 300). The exemption holds only where the whole payment of the occasion is within the limit; a larger payment is wholly taxable, so it is entered in full as SPECIAL_ALLOWANCE (the class refuses an amount above the limit). Enter one entry per occasion (entry.quantity 1). It is a wage: 報酬 for social insurance (健康保険法 art.3(5); 厚生年金保険法 art.3(1)(iii)) and 賃金 for labour insurance (労働保険徴収法 art.2(2)). Entry: quantity = occasions; `lookup.limit_per_unit` is the dated non-taxable limit per occasion.

eligibility: return ctx.entry.quantity > 0;

description: The entry quantity is the Article 12 average-wage base for the disciplinary reduction (average daily wage multiplied by the deducted days). Each deduction is limited to half that base and to one tenth of the wages payable for the wage period.

references.title: 労働基準法91条: each disciplinary wage deduction is limited to half the actual daily average wage; aggregate wage-period discipline deductions are limited to one tenth of the wages payable for that wage period. Actual prior deductions remain ledger records. Entry: quantity = the average-wage base for the deducted days; `lookup` holds the half-wage and one-tenth caps and the average-wage source policy.

eligibility: return ctx.entry.quantity > 0 && get(ctx.subtotals, 'ORDINARY_WAGES', 0) > 0;
conversion:
const cap = get(ctx.subtotals, 'ORDINARY_WAGES', 0) * ctx.lookup.wage_period_share;
return Math.min(ctx.entry.quantity * ctx.lookup.rate, cap);

description: The entry quantity is the unpaid wage left after exit. Interest runs at 14.6% a year from the day after the contractual due date to the payment date. It is not salary income.

references.quote: 退職した労働者の未払賃金には、年十四・六パーセントの遅延利息を付す。

conversion:
const days = calendar_distance_days(ctx.subject.employment.final_pay_due_on, ctx.entry.incurred_on);
return (ctx.entry.quantity * ctx.lookup.annual_rate * days) / 365;
